subject.title: [Feature Request]: one-line local bootstrap for daemon + dashboard auth + Telegram owner setup

question: Which first-class bootstrap shape should OpenClaw own for local gateway, dashboard auth, Telegram bot token, and Telegram owner access?
rationale: Current source has enough building blocks to implement the feature, but the permanent CLI surface and Telegram trust model require maintainer intent before automation adds flags or a wrapper.

options.title: Extend non-interactive onboarding
options.body: Add explicit Telegram bot token, owner numeric ID/resolver, and DM-policy/preapproval flags to openclaw onboard while preserving pairing as an explicit trust boundary.

options.title: Add dedicated bootstrap command
options.body: Create a higher-level local bootstrap command that composes onboard, dashboard URL generation, channel add, and Telegram allowlist/preapproval without expanding the base onboard surface.

options.title: Keep separate commands and document
options.body: Document the supported sequence using existing commands and defer a new CLI surface until the Telegram allowlist/default issues are resolved.

recommendation.title: Extend non-interactive onboarding
recommendation.body: Add explicit Telegram bot token, owner numeric ID/resolver, and DM-policy/preapproval flags to openclaw onboard while preserving pairing as an explicit trust boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent cross-surface history across onboarding, daemon, dashboard auth, and pairing documentation.
